## Highlights

Polishes the JavaScript and TypeScript release introduced in Zova 0.26.0 and
corrects package and repository metadata for reliable installation and
publication.

## What's changed

- Published the JavaScript and TypeScript package as `zova-js`, with stable
  platform-native companion package names for macOS, Linux, and Windows.
- Corrected the GitHub repository owner to `ata-sesli` across package metadata,
  release artifacts, documentation, and the Go module path.
- Fixed JavaScript release packaging, TypeScript artifact builds, native-package
  lookup, and npm trusted-publishing workflow configuration.
- Stabilized Windows JavaScript tests and Rust lifecycle tests in slower CI
  environments.

## Compatibility

- Package and C ABI versions advance to `0.26.1`.
- The `.zova` on-disk format remains format 9; no database migration is
  required from Zova 0.26.0.
- The Go module path is now
  `github.com/ata-sesli/zova/bindings/go`.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ata-sesli/zova/compare/v0.26.0...v0.26.1
